summary: Deprecated in npm in favour of @lottiefiles/dotlottie-react. It has not shipped since March 2024, its React peer stops at 18, and its dependency tree brings sharp 0.33.5 with an install script plus LGPL-3.0 libvips. Do not adopt it.
reasoning: npm marks the package deprecated: superseded by @lottiefiles/dotlottie-react.
Last release 1.6.19 on 2024-03-21; no release in more than 12 months.
The dependency tree pulls @dotlottie/common -> @dotlottie/dotlottie-js -> sharp 0.33.5, which declares install: node install/check.
The tree includes @img/sharp-libvips-darwin-arm64 under LGPL-3.0-or-later, which fails the permissive-license constraint.
The React peer is ^16.8 || ^17 || ^18, excluding React 19.
caveats: React 19 not supported by the peer range.
